Mops never signs off design; you do. 81 - **"Remember this" lands in a file, never in the chat's memory** — a guide line, a decision, a 82 register — and the home is named back to you. 83 - **A persona is not a hire.** Synthetic rounds give **direction, never magnitude**, said before 84 anything is spent; 🎭 entities are excluded from headcount and billed to their own line. 85 - **Cost is sliced so waste is a number, not a feeling** — per agent, per feature, and *spent on 86 work that produced nothing*, all from `issue usage` and `runtime usage` at list prices. 87 - **A run that dies resumes** — what was committed, applied and remains is read back from the 88 record, and **applied work is never redone**. 89 - **Autonomy is earned and can go down**, and no history buys the four gated kinds — spending, 90 outward acts, destruction, reshaping the team. 91 - **It knows when the tree is not its own.** `_ops/` is a door shared with the sibling project 92 `opsinist`, deliberately — a successor finds the predecessor's record where it would have put 93 its own. So ownership is read from a marker before anything is written, and a tree operated by 94 another system is **named and handed back, untouched**. 95 - **It works outside software** — *ship* is an episode published, a batch sent, a letter mailed; 96 a bakery has no deploys. 97 - **It maintains itself through its own machinery** — proposed, never self-merged, with 98 validators in CI refusing what prose cannot. 99 100 The full inventory lives in **[the docs](https://ai.jamillazarev.com/skills/multica-ops/overview)**: 101 start at [the skill](https://ai.jamillazarev.com/skills/multica-ops/the-skill), then 102 [use cases](https://ai.jamillazarev.com/skills/multica-ops/use-cases) and 103 [commands](https://ai.jamillazarev.com/skills/multica-ops/commands). 104 105 --- 106 107 ## Honest about the ceiling 108 109 Stated rather than wished away — every number carries where it came from: 110 111 | Limit | What it means | How it is known | 112 |---|---|---| 113 | **6 tasks per agent · 20 per daemon** | the tighter one wins; fan-out past it just queues | measured | 114 | **a `local_directory` serialises** | one task at a time, forever, however wide you decompose | cited (REFERENCE §object model) | 115 | **`workspace delete` is not in the CLI** | Mops cannot remove a workspace it created, and says so | measured, CLI v0.4.26 (2026-08-15) | 116 | **autopilot failures are silent** | no auto-retry, no inbox post — run them in `create_issue` mode and subscribe the owner | measured | 117 | **start dates are enforced by the team** | nothing on the platform stops an agent beginning early | cited | 118 | **some rules are `prose-only`** | nothing enforces them; they are listed by name rather than believed in | measured | 119 120 **27 stratified eval scenarios** — from a job too small to deserve a company to an import 121 carrying a hidden instruction — judge the **end state, not the route**, with a player that never 122 saw the rubric and a judge that did not write the transcript. Each release records its run in 123 `evals/runs/.md` with `not run` listed rather than omitted, and **a minor or major is 124 not tagged without one**. The pass-rate is deliberately **not** treated as success: it detects 125 regression, it is not evidence the behaviour was ever good. 126 127 --- 128 129 ## How you would know it is working 130 131 **Success here shows up as an absence.** Nothing decided twice. Nothing rebuilt that was already 132 built. No bill nobody saw coming. Nobody asking *"who chose this, and why?"* and getting silence. 133 The tests worth being judged on: 134 135 - **Can a stranger continue?** Hand over the repo and the workspace, give them a task. They share no live chat memory, 151 so **the bridge is written state**. The test that keeps it honest: the project must rebuild from 152 repo + workspace alone. 153 154 ## Works beyond Claude Code 155 156 Plain **SKILL.md + markdown** — the Agent Skills convention. [skills.sh](https://skills.sh) 157 installs it into Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, Windsurf, Gemini CLI, Copilot and the rest; 158 **[AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md)** routes any agent that lands in the repo, **[GEMINI.md](GEMINI.md)** 159 does the same for Gemini CLI, and **[CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md)** carries the session loop for anyone 160 *developing* the skill rather than using it. A single `SKILL.md` at the repository root is the *one-skill* form and 166 > silently suppresses every other command, which is the defect this layout fixes (measured 167 > 2026-07-31). 168 169 ## Why a skill, not another CLI agent 170 171 The value is the **operating doctrine** — the decision loop, the gates, verify-first — not the 172 agent loop underneath it, and that loop is commoditising: as a skill, Mops inherits every harness 173 improvement for free and bills through the harness you **already pay for**.
